notes: Feature-fusion positional-join bug found in the OFFLINE training pipeline (99.35% of fused rows mispaired) has been fixed via a stable original_id join in src/fusion/fusion_core.py, and the models in models/ were retrained on the corrected dataset. The LIVE single-function inference path (ml_bridge.run_prediction) never had this bug -- confirmed separately, since it has no cross-file positional join at all.
maintained_by: Manually updated whenever the ML baseline changes (a retrain, a threshold change, a newly discovered issue). backend/ci_scan.py reads this file at scan time so CI/PR-comment text is never hand-typed and cannot silently go stale relative to this file -- but this file itself is not auto-generated by the training pipeline and must be kept in sync by whoever changes the baseline.
